# IVD degeneration partial fabrication variant C

Transcriptional remodeling in degenerated IVD tissues included changes in structural and inflammatory genes. FOXF1 was upregulated (Table 4). PAX1 was upregulated (Table 4). KRT18 was downregulated (Table 4). SOX9 was upregulated (Table 4). ACAN was upregulated (Table 4). COL2A1 was upregulated (Table 4). MMP13 was upregulated (Table 4). TNF was upregulated (Table 4).
